text:
Sometimes I meet her in the world
and she passes beside me;
she passes smiling, and I say:
“How can she laugh?”

Then another smile comes to my lips,
a mask for pain,
and I think: “Perhaps she laughs
as I do!”

translation.title: Rhyme XLIX: Sometimes I Meet Her in the World
